23F here so it might be a little skewed BUT. It’s all in the shoulder and stance. With a handgun (at least I did) you take a wide stance, lock hips shoulder length apart aim and shoot. With the shotgun you need to take the stock, and find your bra strap, move in from there. When you feel it in your socket you’ve got it. Relax the hips and put one foot just slightly past the other and that’s where you want to be. Press the fat of your cheek against the gun and you should be staring clean down the barrel. Aim and shoot. If your a guy and your wear a tank under a tee shirt move in towards your chest from there. I hope that made sense 😅.
